description: §22.4.1 / §22.12 (S459 round 3) positive — the closed attribute list admits ordinary markup in both phases: `class`, `title`, `data-x`, `aria-label`, an `https:` `href`, and SVG `viewBox` pass in compile-time `emit()` output and in runtime `meta.emit` output, and reach the rendered DOM.
rationale: §22.12 *Attributes — a CLOSED list*: global, data-*, aria-*, per-element HTML (href on <a>, URL scheme-judged) and SVG presentation names are admitted. (ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S458 "a" + PA addendum 3 (S459 review of a7480c675))
